evidenceType: blind matched-frame continuity comparison plus isolated spatial-batch route trace

blindVisual.finding: The two sequences are visually equivalent from 9200 to 9300ms; the continuous fade has no new pop, seam, hole, or band.
blindVisual.artifactCaveat: Red ground triangles and noisy speckled groundcover occur in both sequences and are not newly attributable to the spatial split.

evidenceIntegrity.reason: Round44 is internally consistent, but Round43 and Round44 are separate sessions. Round44's hidden-groundcover lead-in already contains 48.5 and 66.8ms stalls while Round43's lead-in is near 6ms, so the full timing collapse cannot be assigned solely to batching.

analyticBounds.layout: 21x21 stream slots mapped into a 6x6 batch grid at 4x4 chunks per batch

critic.workloadCause: Three whole-field InstancedMeshes became 36 batches times three streams, or 108 separately bounded meshes and buffers. Fixed-capacity slots rose from 441 to 576 per species, a 30.6 percent increase. Culling bought no median reduction and added submission variability.
critic.largestGap: Catastrophic frame-time stability blocks further visual refinement.
critic.requiredNext: Revert only the 4x4 spatial split and restore Round43's three whole-field InstancedMeshes while preserving continuous alpha-hash and visibility hysteresis.
